lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately four horizontal rows of discrete, high-luminance circular clusters are visible along the lateral flank, with the density of points decreasing and the spatial separation increasing toward the caudal peduncle.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of subtly elevated pixel intensity are visible, intersecting the horizontal rows of blobs to create a coordinate-like grid across the mid-section of the flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal feature is visible along the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a sharp luminance transition from light on the dorsal edge to deep shadow on the ventral edge, extending from the dorsal fin base toward the head.

other_distinctive_markers: Visible high-luminance spotting on the anterior edge of the upper caudal fin lobe, distinct from the primary flank constellation.
